fields.name: Yours
fields.value:
`/profile` your record: rank, unit, ops attended, no-shows, warnings, rating
`/code` the private server code
`/roblox` link or update your Roblox username
`/continent` change where you're playing from
`/unit` switch between Ground Unit and Sniper Unit
`/op list` what's coming up
`/op join` and `/op leave` RSVP without touching the buttons
`/op roster` who's signed up for an op
`/rate` and `/rating-history` rate someone after an op, see their feedback
`/activity` and `/inactive` who's around and who's gone quiet

fields.name: Command only
fields.value:
`/op create`, `/op edit`, `/op close`, `/op cancel`
`/promote`, `/demote`
`/warn`, `/warns`, `/unwarn`, `/nickname`
`/record`, `/panel`, `/setup`, `/ranks-setup`
`/code-set` also works for whoever holds **Server Host**

fields.name: Where
fields.value: Use them in <#1542531684023406674>. Command runs theirs in `#command-commands`. Most replies are only visible to you.
